title: Pool Lifecycle Gauntlet
prompt: Implement the full `BytePool` lifecycle: acquire until exhausted (nullptr after), release back (noteFree), and reuse released blocks. The tracker's live count must always equal blocks-out minus blocks-returned.

tests.name: acquire, exhaust, release, reuse
tests.hint: Free-list of block pointers: acquire pops (nullptr when empty, noteAlloc), release pushes (noteFree) — live() stays consistent automatically.

tests.name: release of both blocks restores everything
tests.hint: Three acquires then three releases: available()==3, live()==0, allocs==frees==3.
